description: Convert JPG photos to PNG format instantly in your browser. Handles multiple files at once with individual downloads or a single ZIP archive.

faqs.a: PNG is lossless and supports transparency, which makes it better for graphics, logos and screenshots. JPG is smaller and better for photos.
Yes — JPG does not support transparency, so there is nothing to recover. The PNG keeps every pixel of the JPG exactly as it was.
No. Conversion happens on a canvas in your browser. Your photos are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Drop one or more JPG/JPEG files into the upload zone.
Click “Convert to PNG” — each image is re-encoded as a lossless PNG.
Check the per-file size table (PNGs are usually larger than JPGs).
Download each PNG individually or all together as a ZIP.
title: JPG to PNG Converter
